title: Self-Registering Provider Registry
instructions: In `providers.py` make `Provider` register its subclasses automatically with `__init_subclass__` (no metaclass): honour the `name=` class keyword, require a `complete` override, reject duplicate names without registering the failing class, and forward other class keywords. Implement `Provider.create` to build a registered provider from keyword config.

evidence.label: Subclasses register under their lowercase name or the name= keyword, and store it as cls.name
A duplicate name fails with TypeError at class creation
A subclass without complete() fails at creation and is not registered
create() passes config as keywords; unknown names raise UnknownProvider listing known ones
Indirect subclasses register under their own name and inherit complete
A failed duplicate leaves the original registration intact
Unknown class keywords are forwarded to super().__init_subclass__
